description: This file defines the interface (abstract class) ILocalStore within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares several pure virtual methods for managing a local storage table, including opening storage, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entry counts and entries, removing entries, and adding entries. It also defines a shared pointer type alias for this interface.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface for local storage operations, providing methods for managing tables and entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Open the storage at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Create a new table with the given name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Set a limit on the number of entries for a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieve the count of entries within a range starting at 'start', up to 'maxCount'.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Get a list of entries from a table starting at 'start' with 'count' number of entries.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Remove entries in a table from 'start' to 'end' indices.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Add an entry to a specified table.
